pages.name: Plot a reading
pages.task: At 4 h a generator had used 5 L, an example reading. Drag the point to plot it.
pages.why: Each square along is 2 h, so 4 h is 2 squares. Each square up is 5 L, so 5 L is 1 square. The reading sits at (4, 5).
